config.description: The trigger config, passed verbatim to the engine — e.g. `{ "expression": "0 */5 * * * *" }` for cron, or a `state` scope/key.

label.description: A short human label echoed back in the notification text.

once.description: Auto-unsubscribe after the first delivered notification. Defaults to true for one-shot-ish types (state / stream / custom trigger types), false for recurring `cron`.

session_id.description: The owning session. Injected by the harness from the calling turn; a model-supplied value is overridden (you cannot subscribe for another session).

trigger_type.description: The iii trigger type to listen on: `cron`, `state`, `stream`, or another worker's custom trigger type (e.g. `approval::pending-resolved`). For an ad-hoc signal, subscribe to `state` on a key and have the signaller call `state::set` on it (no dedicated emit needed — the engine fans the trigger out to every subscriber).

once.description: The effective `once` flag applied (after the per-type default).
